summary: Performance Shipping files a 6-K announcing bondholder approval to amend its 9.875% senior secured bonds issued July 15, 2025. The amendments release existing security (ship mortgages on P. Monterey and P. Sophia), converting bonds to senior unsecured; remove sale-of-collateral use-of-proceeds restrictions; and raise the minimum liquidity covenant from $20M to $30M. A one-time amendment fee of 0.325% on $150M nominal amount is paid. The board negotiated these changes to reflect improved credit quality after fleet expansion and debt reduction. Watch for the amendment and restatement agreement execution and potential impact on bond trading and refinancing risk.
